          Health Screening Center  The Health Screening Center at MedPark Hospital caters to individuals over 15 desiring a health checkup. Health checkup items vary from person to person based on age and risk factors of diseases. Initial screening for risk factors of asymptomatic latent diseases, especially high-acuity and complicated ones like cancer, diabetes, and heart disease, can help reduce the risk of developing such diseases and their complications if abnormalities are detected and promptly treated. For diseases detected during health screening, prompt referral to specialists for early treatment without waiting for symptoms to manifest are routine practices.  At MedPark Hospital's Health Screening Center, health checkups are performed by doctors specialized in preventive medicine. The center offers comprehensive screening programs harnessing advanced and efficient health screening equipment. Individuals undergoing health checkups at the center will receive a specific recommendation on health preventive measures, leading to improved quality of life.  Why the Health Screening Center at MedPark Hospital?   We offer personalized guidance and care strategies to proactively address health concerns related to personal habits and genetic factors. This data can be gleaned from a family history of immediate family members, particularly for common inherited conditions, visible physical abnormalities, previous irregular medical results, and behaviors that could impact disease development. e.g., individuals with a family history of cancer or diabetes and the regular consumption of alcohol or cigarette smoking.  The center is equipped with comprehensive health screening devices that provide diagnostic tests such as blood tests, X-rays, ultrasound, EKG , tumor marker tests, complete blood count, lipid profile, blood glucose test, liver and kidney function tests, etc. With experience in providing health screening services, we offer accurate, convenient, rapid, and safe health screening.  We provide services through a team of highly skilled, specialized physicians dedicated to meeting high professional standards . Our center, staffed with trained nurses, nursing assistants, and patient care assistants, provides compassionate care for every patient.   Heath screening services and items   Vital signs and physical examinations performed by physicians  Eye refraction test with automatic refractometer  Biomicroscopy eye examination by an ophthalmologist  Thin Prep Pap test  HPV DNA test  Complete blood count (CBC)  Blood glucose tests   Fasting blood sugar  Hemoglobin A1C    Lipid profile   Total cholesterol  HDL cholesterol  LDL cholesterol  Triglycerides    Kidney function tests   BUN  Creatinine  eGFR    Uric acid  Liver function tests   GGT  Alkaline phosphatase  Albumin  Globulin  AST(SGOT)  ALT(SGPT)  Total Bilirubin  Direct Bilirubin  Total Protein    Thyroid function tests   TSH  Free T4    Tumor marker tests   PSA  CEA  AFP  CA-125    Urine and stool tests   Urinalysis  Stool analysis, fecal occult blood test    Medical Imagings   Chest X-rays  Ultrasound of the whole abdomen  Bone mineral density  Digital mammogram and breast ultrasound    Cardiovascular exams   Exercise Stress Test (EST/Echo)  Electrocardiography (EKG)  Ankle-brachial index  Carotid duplex ultrasound    Vitamin blood levels   Vitamin B12 level  Vitamin D level     Health screening programs   Pre-employment health examination  Health checkups for contracted companies  Periodic health examination  Personalized health checkup  Vaccination for contracted companies  Fit-for-work examination  Driver's license health checkup   Specialties   Preventive medicine  Prevention is always better than cure. This is especially true when it comes to diseases and illnesses. At MedPark Health Screening Center, our team of preventive medicine specialists has a deep understanding of how to prevent various health problems. We provide comprehensive physical examinations, ranging from basic checkups to in-depth screenings, tailored to the individual needs of each patient and age group. This allows us to identify health risk factors with precision.   Everybody is unique. Therefore, the potential health risks that each patient may face in the future are different and require different care plans. We subscribe to the tenet that personalized preventive care is the key to a healthier future.  At MedPark Health Screening Center, we are committed to providing you with personalized and compassionate care to help you achieve your best possible health. We take the time to understand your health risks and needs and work with you to develop a tailored care plan optimized for you. Our team of skilled and caring healthcare providers is ready to assist you in your path to improved health, adept at addressing health risks early on and averting severe health problems in time. Remember, good health is not for sale; you must earn it.
